reserveReview.rationale: Sygnum identifies each FIUSD as one unit of Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund USD Fund Class G Acc. The official October 2, 2026 USD Fund holdings report, pages 3-4, supplies a complete $10,163,457,885.50 fund-portfolio denominator and six reported security-type percentages totaling 100.00%. These are dated per-unit look-through fund allocations, not a FIUSD-token-supply-to-held-fund-units reconciliation or token-scoped assurance. The October 14 daily workbook independently identifies Class G Acc ISIN IE00BNKLND78, NAV $12,061.69 and 1,518.17 outstanding share-class units. The fresh native token census is 1,517.66 zkSync plus zero Arbitrum units; a whole-share-class total does not identify Sygnum's fiduciary holdings or explain the 0.51-unit difference. Neither source is the separate Fidelity USD Treasury Fund, a liquidity guarantee or a token-level recovery contract. Existing medium risk classifications are retained; issuer-specific exposure, whole-position liquidation and contractual maturity maxima are not inferred from aggregate categories, WAM, or WAL.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact FIUSD Class G fund-unit claim; dated full USD Fund portfolio security-type allocation, without token-unit reconciliation or assurance inference
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dated October 2 Fidelity USD Fund report classifies all six security types, so zero here means no unclassified underlying-fund category, not zero token-level uncertainty. Exact current FIUSD fiduciary unit-to-token attribution, custody/subcustody allocation and executable liquidity remain unresolved. Source-maintenance review 2026-10-15 retrieved official holdings, the August Class G factsheet and the October 14 daily NAV/share-class workbook. The latter reports 1,518.17 whole-class units but does not allocate them to FIUSD; it is not a token-to-unit reconciliation. The central Fidelity document library and prospectus returned HTTP 403 through static retrieval; the library's browser view requires client-category self-certification, and direct prospectus navigation did not yield readable evidence. Parse the USD fund section, not GBP/EUR or USD Treasury funds. Preserve configured portfolio-scope scoring exclusion and existing 48-hour source/fetch fallback; the historical issuer application describes monthly holdings publication but does not establish the current cadence.
